name: WIDAD
recent: Widad Group Berhad 近期有多项重大诉讼与清盘/接管相关公告，同时有一家子公司已全额结清应付给 St Tunnel (M) 的 199 万 RGT 款项。公司于 2026 年 9 月 1 日出现董事会及多个委员会的人事变动。最新财报显示 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收同比下滑 29.7%，但净利同比增长 57.8%。
notable: 公司出现多项清盘/接管/限制令/特别管理相关公告。
公司面临重大诉讼事项。
子公司已全额结清应付给 St Tunnel (M) 的 199 万 RGT 款项。
risks: 公司出现清盘/接管相关公告，需留意后续进展。
董事会及多个委员会于 2026 年 9 月 1 日出现人事变动。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 2415.5 万令吉，环比下降 10.8%，同比下降 29.7%；净利为 95 万令吉，环比下降 8.0%，同比增长 57.8%；净利率为 3.9%，高于上季度的 3.8%。

recent_en: Widad Group Berhad has recently made several announcements on material litigation and winding-up/receivership matters, while a unit has fully settled MYR 1.99 million RGT payable to St Tunnel (M). The company saw boardroom and committee changes on 1 September 2026. The latest quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 show revenue down 29.7% year-on-year but net profit up 57.8% year-on-year.
notable_en: The company made several announcements related to winding-up/receivership/restraining order/special administrator.
The company is involved in material litigation.
A subsidiary has fully settled MYR 1.99 million RGT payable to St Tunnel (M).
risks_en: Winding-up/receivership-related announcements have been made; further developments should be monitored.
The company is involved in material litigation.
Boardroom and multiple committee changes occurred on 1 September 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 24.155 million, down 10.8% QoQ and down 29.7% YoY; net income was MYR 0.95 million, down 8.0% QoQ but up 57.8% YoY; net margin was 3.9%, up from 3.8% in the previous quarter.
